job:
Frontend Engineer — Brightline Health

We're hiring a Frontend Engineer to build the dashboards clinicians use every day.

You will:
- Build data visualization features in React and TypeScript
- Contribute to our design system
- Write end-to-end tests with Playwright
- Improve performance and accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA)

You have:
- 2+ years with React and TypeScript
- Experience with Next.js and Tailwind CSS
- Familiarity with GraphQL is a plus

analysis.summary: You cover the core stack and have built dashboards, which is the heart of this role. The gaps are end-to-end testing with Playwright and accessibility work. If you have done either, add it; if not, mention them as areas you are learning.

coverLetter:
Dear Brightline Health team,

I'm applying for the Frontend Engineer role. For the past three years I have built React and Next.js apps in TypeScript at Acme Analytics, including dashboards used by 40 internal teams, so building the dashboards your clinicians rely on is close to the work I do every day.

At Acme I also contribute to the shared design system and write tests for critical flows such as checkout. I'm keen to grow my end-to-end testing and accessibility skills, and your focus on both is a big part of why this role appeals to me.

Thank you for your time. I would be glad to walk you through my work.

Alex Morgan
